_comment: In-app Browser pane (mcp__Claude_Browser__*) host ALLOWLIST. See ops/lessons.md L-013.
The pane shares the desktop app's GPU child process: a page that kills it takes the
in-flight turn of EVERY session in the app with it. Local dev servers and own-build
previews are the traffic this surface exists for; arbitrary third-party pages are not.
Loopback hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, *.localhost, 0.0.0.0) are allowed by the
hook itself and need no entry here. Add a host below ONLY after deciding that loading
it in the shared-GPU pane is worth the blast radius; claude-in-chrome runs in a
separate Chrome process and is never denied, so it is almost always the better answer.
Each entry: host (exact or parent domain - subdomains match), why, added (date).
